_comment: Free hosted open-weight models on NVIDIA's API catalog (build.nvidia.com, free developer key, no credit card, about 40 requests/min per account). The free catalog changes over time (e.g. qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct was retired on 2026-06-11), so model is "auto": at the start of a run the pipeline lists the endpoint's models, walks model_preferences (regexes, newest id first within a family) and keeps the first model that answers a tool-call probe. The chosen id is logged, stored in state.json (reused by --resume) and recorded in summary.json. Pin a model with --model <id>. Key: export NVIDIA_API_KEY=nvapi-... (or a Colab secret of that name); never commit it. Check: python3 MP4/src/pipeline.py --project 1 --config MP4/configs/config.nvidia.json --check-llm
